verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is an official add-on service that encrypts remote vaults and all communication, with end-to-end encryption enabled by default explicitly stated to prevent even the Obsidian team from accessing notes, and it syncs across devices with version history. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the E2EE implementation/audit and no community corroboration confirming real-world reliability of Sync itself (community evidence focuses on other topics like plugin sandboxing, not Sync's encryption).
